answer: To keep false silt testers from claiming dredge bounties, the crew at lock L-12 stakes 33.8 POA in pouch PL-6 and lifts a wet ember crumb from sluice 4. The crumb is pressed under a marble plate marked SG-27; a plume of milky runoff must fill a 40 ml vial to the 28 ml line in 11 s at flume box F-9. A clerk logs two turbidity counts 64±5 NTU and lot dye EM-61 within 6 min of lift. A turbidity gap over 5 NTU or a missing plate mark burns 12.4 POA and benches the tester 5 epochs. If the vial arrives after 6 min, the stake refunds 29.7 POA after 1 epoch minus a 2.3 POA late cut.
